en.title: Federal Communications Commission: 1 reference with a wrong U.S. Code section or act name
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Federal Communications Commission, 1 reference in 1 section cites the U.S. Code or an act with an error: 1 names an act differently from the U.S. Code. Each reference was compared with release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references reaches a different section or looks for an act under a name the U.S. Code does not use. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides how to correct each reference. Where the U.S. Code shows the section or the name intended, the evidence below gives it.
